decls.name: cutOutField

paper_span.quote: If \(X=\langle\chi\rangle\), we say that this field is cut out by

decls.rationale: `cutOutField m chi` formalizes the field *cut out by* a Dirichlet character: the fixed field of the kernel of \(\mathrm{Gal}(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_m)/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^\times \xrightarrow{\chi} \mathbb{C}^\times\).

decls.name: cyclicCubicSubfield

paper_span.quote: let \(L_i\) be the cyclic cubic subfield of \(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{r_i})\), and put \(M=L_1\cdots L_\ell\).

decls.rationale: `cyclicCubicSubfield r` is the paper's \(L_i\): the unique cyclic cubic subfield of \(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{r_i})\) for a prime \(r_i \equiv 1 \pmod 3\), realised as the fixed field of the index-3 subgroup of cubes.
